Rachel / team —

I've gone through ClearWave's redlines and summarized high-level positions below. I'll follow up with line-by-line comments (track changes) but wanted to call out items that will materially affect execution.

1) Retention (6 months) — Non-starter as written for all raw telemetry and full KV cache. Proposed approach: accept 6-month retention for application-level generated embeddings or derived artifacts where feasible, but we need to preserve short-lived KV caches and operational logs for troubleshooting (30-90 days). Suggest a compromise clause: "customer data stored for serving (embeddings, structured outputs) will be retained up to 6 months; ephemeral runtime caches and logs excluded and retained only as necessary for operational reliability for up to 90 days."

2) Subprocessor inventory & notice — We can provide a near-complete list of subprocessors (redacted for internal IP) and a clear process for notices. We cannot agree to pre-approval for every subprocessor; instead propose a 30-day notice requirement and an objection right limited to legitimate data-protection-based grounds.

3) SOC 2 evidence — We can provide a SOC 2 summary report and an auditor-approved SSAE letter. Full Type II report requires an NDA; offer to share via a controlled link (Doc/Share) and provide SOC scope description.

4) Transfers / SCCs — For cross-border transfers, Redwood's standard is to rely on SCCs where necessary. For customers requiring an EU-US Addendum, we can include the addendum as an appendix — but need to avoid duplicative contractual obligations. Recommend offering SCCs + an appropriately scoped EU-US addendum on request.

5) Security obligations and indemnities — ClearWave added stronger indemnity language tied to regulatory fines. We need to narrow the indemnity exposure and tie it to Redwood's willful misconduct or breach of security obligations.

Next steps: I'll send a redlined DPA with the proposed compromise language marked up and include a suggested execution path (DocuSign envelope vs AdobeSign). If procurement requires an AdobeSign workflow, we can route.

Monica Patel
